description: This Java class 'ResourceDeletedStrategy' defines a strategy to handle 'ResourceDeleted' events within the Eclipse Ditto policies persistence framework. It extends an abstract strategy class and overrides the method to modify a policy builder by removing a resource based on event data.

classes.name: ResourceDeletedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that extends 'AbstractPolicyEventStrategy' to handle 'ResourceDeleted' events by updating policy configurations.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the abstract method to process a 'ResourceDeleted' event and modify the 'PolicyBuilder' by removing the specified resource.
